### Bug Fixes
- **translation:** complete a version when a failed job beside it has nothing left to translate - **bridge:** return focus to a note reference after its paragraph was translated - **bridge:** dim a restored paragraph as untranslated again - **translation:** drop a dropped element's content even when its opening tag is malformed - **reader:** open the translation at the previous chapter's end after a backward edge turn, and skip a superseded load's translations - **translation:** drop a starting translation's tracking when the reader picks another language - **translation:** adopt a job after relaunch only while its language is still the chosen one - **translation:** after relaunch, count an adopted job's progress and leave a failure that later work covered - **translation:** read quoted attribute values whole, and keep a tag with an unclosed quote as text so the markup after it survives - **reader:** turn the book when the reader turns past the translation's edge - **follow:** measure translated paragraphs when following into a translation - **reader:** keep nested paragraphs when translating, and restore the originals a translation no longer covers - **translation:** run a request on the passages it was asked for, through the disclosure, and drop a cancelled preparation - **translation:** keep a paused chapter's Resume while a passage is translated again, and bring back a failed job of the newest version - **translation:** pause each of a closing window's jobs by its current state and refresh once a version's state is saved - **translation:** end a malformed tag at the next bracket so the markup after an unclosed attribute survives - **reader:** fit the changed-passages note in a pane at its minimum width - **bridge:** keep every marked note reference in a translated paragraph, as the passage reader does - **translation:** relink a paused job by its own passages, adopt only a job of the remembered choice, and own restores - **translation:** own every translation version's state app-wide and pause all of a closing window's jobs - **translation:** run job requests off the main actor, parse each resource once a run, and drop late or orphaned results - **bookkit:** keep every marked note reference reachable in translation, whatever its label - **providers:** mark note references so a literal bracketed number in a book stays text - **providers:** reject a model reply with text outside its numbered blocks - **providers:** split a paragraph over 3,000 characters even when it fits the model's context - **store:** list the missing-translation message in the string catalog - **store:** read a saved translation of any length, so one long paragraph can't hide its chapter - **translation:** keep no-break spaces in translated text and drop only an embed's tag - **translation:** keep an unterminated tag as literal text, read in one pass
### Performance
